---
name: Feature request
about: A capability the API or its clients should have
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**The job to be done** — what are you trying to do that you can't today?

**Where it belongs** — is this a `/v1` route (the product), a client surface
(app/MCP), an ingest adapter, or the integration layer (SDK/webhooks)?

**Prior art** — does an existing route, kernel function, or timeline event
already cover part of this?

Note: posting back to chat (`send_message`) is deliberately out of scope — the
system drafts, humans send. Requests for it will be closed as by-design.
